1.t: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—

2.t: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—

3.t: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child

4.t: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle

5.t: Do they think that no one has power over them

7.t: Do they think that no one sees them

8.t: Have We not given them two eyes

10.t: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺

11.t: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺

12.t: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is

13.t: It is to free a slave

14.t: or to give food in times of famine
14.tr: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

16.t: or to a poor person in distress

17.t: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion
17.tr: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo Wa-tawaasaw bissabri Wa-tawaasaw bilmarhamah

18.t: These are the people of the right

19.t: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left
19.tr: Wallazeena kafaroo bi-aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah

20.t: The Fire will be sealed over them
